messages.body:
Dear Linnet Lane events team,

Thank you for coming to our community open day at the Westquay depot in September. The Hallbrook Community Fund trustees met on Tuesday 27 October to agree the autumn round, and I promised to let each partner charity know where things landed before the end of the month.

This round we received 41 applications against a pot of 18,000 pounds. The trustees have prioritised projects that keep people active and connected through the winter, and we have funded the Port Cressing lunch club, the Tidemouth young carers' trips and two community allotments. Your application for the bereavement walking group was not funded this time, but the trustees asked me to say it scored well and they would welcome it again in the spring round, which opens on 1 March.

Our volunteering days will continue into next year. If your shops or the hospice gardens could use a team of eight to ten colleagues for a day, please send me a few dates in February or March and I will put them to the depot managers.

Separately, under our matched giving scheme for colleagues: we will match the sponsorship raised by our colleague Dev Raghunathan (transport planner, Westquay) for his Kestrel Coast Marathon run for Linnet Lane Hospice, pound for pound up to the scheme limit of 300 pounds. His page has passed that, so the match is 300 pounds in full, and our payment of 300.00 pounds will reach your bank account by 6 November with the reference HCF-MG-2611. Please treat this email as our written confirmation of the match.

Finally, the fund's annual report will be published in January and will mention every partner charity; if you would like a different description of the hospice from last year's, let me know by 30 November.

With best wishes,

Eleri Vaughan-Price
Community Fund Coordinator
Hallbrook Logistics Ltd, Westquay Depot, Port Cressing

Checked the ledger: the gift was made in March 2025 to Idris's page for last year's 10k, outside the refund window. Not refunded; Nia to reply.
Hi Ewan, I'm sorry, that gift was made in March 2025 and we can't refund it now. Thank you for your support.
I'm retiring in November and won't pay income tax after that. Please stop claiming Gift Aid on my gifts from December.
Declaration end date set to 30 November 2026 in the CRM; gifts up to then stay eligible.
Thanks Valerie, we've updated your declaration so we stop claiming from December.
Could I have a receipt for my donation to Ruth's page?
Receipt re-sent from the CRM.
Sent you a fresh receipt, Hugh.
I've moved to 4 Quarry Close, Tidemouth.
Address updated; duplicate record merged.
All updated, thank you Pamela.
Could I swap my vest for a medium?
Swapped from spare stock at the tent.
Swapped at the tent, Jonah - see you there.
My page shows Teodora Ivanov - can you fix it?
Asked PledgePath to correct the display name.
Fixed now, Teodora.
Can my medal say Gwen not Gwenllian?
Changed on the engraving list.
Done, Gwen.
We need a receipt for our company donation for our accounts.
Company receipt issued; no Gift Aid on company gifts.
Receipt attached.
My fundraising page won't let me log in.
Password reset link re-sent.
Try the new link, Leon.
Are there photos from the tent?
Pointed to the shared album.
They're in the album link we emailed.
I'd like to set up a monthly gift.
Standing order form sent.
Form on its way.
Have I won the September draw?
Checked the draw list: not this time.
Not this month, Brenda - good luck next time.
I'd like to give in memory of my husband.
In-memory fund set up.
We've set up a tribute fund.
Can you collect a wardrobe?
Passed to retail.
Retail will call you.
Where is the hospice cheer point?
Sent the cheer point plan.
Mile 20, by the lifeboat station.
Can I leave a bag at the tent?
Yes, tent bag drop.
Yes - labelled bags at the tent.
Can I add Gift Aid to raffle tickets?
Explained raffle tickets are not gifts.
Raffle tickets can't carry Gift Aid, sorry.
I'm getting your newsletter twice.
Duplicate supporter record merged.
Merged - you'll get one copy now.
Our club wants to donate to the team.
Company/club gift - no Gift Aid.
Thank you - here's how.
I'd love to volunteer at the tent next year.
Added to volunteer list.
Added you, Rita.
I didn't get a hospice medal at the finish.
Posting a spare.
One is in the post, Oskar.
Just wanted to say thank you for the support.
Shared with the team.
Thank you, Meredith!
Please change my direct debit date.
DD date moved to the 15th.
Done.
Can I buy a hospice T-shirt?
Shop link sent.
Here's the shop link.
Where do I send a cheque?
Gave the hospice address.
Send it to the hospice, FAO Fundraising.
Please add me to your newsletter.
Added with consent recorded.
You're on the list.

messages.text: Good morning Mr. Barrington — the sideboard carcass is glued up and square.
Wonderful news. The family is excited to see it.
Veneer work begins next week; photos to follow.
Mrs. Renard-Whitcomb here: are the chair seats carved yet?
Seat blanks are milled; carving starts Saturday.
Wesley: your lumber order arrived at the yard, dock 3.
Much obliged — I'll collect it Tuesday morning.
Ellis: the rock maple quote is ready when you are.
Hi! Is the hospice tent near the start?
Yes - 200 m past the start pens, by the lifeboat station.
When do vests arrive?
This week - we'll text you.
Where's parking on Sunday?
Park and ride from the college; the seafront is closed.
Can I drop my sponsorship cash at the shop?
Yes, ask for a paying-in slip.
Can my kids come in the tent?
Of course!
Hi Ffion, bad news - the physio says I've got a stress fracture in my left foot so Sunday is off. Can I defer my place to next year's race please? I'll keep my page open.
So sorry Hollie! Yes, that's fine - I've noted your deferral to 2027. Rest up and we'll see you next year.
Thank you so much x
Is the pasta party still on?
Yes, Saturday 6 pm at the church hall.
Sorry, I've been sent on a work trip and won't make Sunday.
Thanks for letting us know, Oona.
Tent's up. Need more cable ties.
Bringing some at 2.
Collected my vest - it fits!
Brilliant, see you at the tent at 8.
All marshals at their points on the hospice stretch.
Charity wave all through the start.
Had to stop at 20 miles, hamstring. Gutted.
So sorry Freya - medics at the tent if you need them.
Finished! 3:58!
Amazing Kieran - come and get your medal.
PB by 6 minutes!
Fantastic Fergus!
Done! Legs have gone.
Well done Shona! Massage table is free now.
Thank you for the jelly babies at mile 20!
Any photos of me at the finish?
A few - we'll send the album link.
My work said they've sent the match letter.
Got it, thanks Tobias.

messages.text: Welcome back, everyone. Staff sync moves to 9:30 Mondays starting this week.
Noted - I will update the shared calendar invite.
Anniversary lecture series: three speakers confirmed for spring. Holding the hall for the second Thursdays.
I will draft the member announcement once the third date locks.
Roof assessment for the Bull Street property is back - repairs scoped under the restoration grant. Summary in the drive.
Actuals are tracking within the grant line. I flagged the January drawdown for the finance review.
Docent orientation is Saturday at 9. Amos is leading the Friday walking tour this month.
December close is done - statement of activities posted for Thursday's review with Reginald.
What a weekend. Thank you all - 44 of ours started and the tent was rammed.
Hollie's out injured, poor thing - I suppose she just loses her place fee?
Photos are going up in the archive this week.
Trustees liked the Kestrel numbers. Full close report after the claim goes in.
Signed Ravi's hardship waiver this morning so it's ready for the close.
Close sheet keyed from the 09:00 export. Platform's final October file still to come.
Gift Aid counts towards the minimum - it always has, it's in the pack.
We claim the Gift Aid on PledgePath gifts ourselves now, don't we?
Dev's employer is matching, I think, but I don't think anything came in writing.
Let's just waive every shortfall under 50 pounds - it's goodwill and not worth the invoices. Bethan, please make it so.
Any refunds I've done go on the desk ticket that asked for them, as usual.
Darius says he wants to defer too - he missed the start because of his car. Same as the injured ones?
Shield should go to Ruth, she was top on the leaderboard last time I looked.
Round the Gift Aid down to the penny - that's what we did for Tidemouth.
Bethan has the close. Policies as written please.
Shall I just text everyone the close-out on WhatsApp? Quicker.
And send the shortfall people a Stripe payment link rather than an invoice, it's slicker.
